scope.statement: Independently reconstruct the combined O_{J,K}(D^(4/5)) count of positive-stress leaf ports and same-chart double ports under a fixed supplied slow-chart atlas, and verify q>=h>=ceil(D) yields D-O(D^(4/5)) uncovered loaded endpoints.
scope.domain: Asymptotic exponent arithmetic for D->infinity, fixed J,K, canonical positive-leaf anchor error O(D^(-1/2)), canonical slow-chart boundary and double-port counts, and canonical post-ZF C-ZRF/C-WOODALL endpoint counts at launch base 7d0a450fe66991036541023f95c44c064a04b6a8.
scope.limitations: The executable verifier checks exponent arithmetic only. The analytic geometry is independently reconstructed but not machine proved. No atlas extraction, source motion, strict-diameter competitor, full-source pair ledger for a moved endpoint, C-II closure, Level I closure, or theorem promotion is claimed.

result: Independent reconstruction supports the conditional combined covered-endpoint bound from canonical inputs. The proposed O(D^(-2/3)) leaf-anchor candidate is unnecessary because canonical O(D^(-1/2)) localization already yields D^(4/5)+D^(1/2)=O(D^(4/5)). The candidate and this review artifact remain unreviewed.
remaining_questions: Can one extract a fixed J,K slow-chart atlas from every canonical C-II source, or construct a same-cardinality full-source competitor from the linearly many endpoints uncovered by the two counted port classes?
